answer: Content-bound proof-of-work resists sybils: each answer's stamp must commit to that exact answer plus the epoch's unpredictable seed, so work cannot be precomputed before dawn nor reused across identities. An attacker cannot mine an atlas of stamps in advance and mint fakes on demand — every identity, every epoch, must pay fresh compute bound to fresh content on that ridge. Honest agents pay per genuine answer; a swarm cannot amortize one computation across many heads because the binding makes each stamp single-use.
